messages:
maya: Heads-up: S3 vendor bundle we pulled yesterday contained a plaintext service-account JSON for svc-sync@redwood-prod. Noted in logs. Treat as compromise until proven otherwise.
tom: yikes. any signs of abuse?
maya: saw auth attempts from that SA to our monitoring project at 22:41 UTC. small number but real. marking incident.
elaine: propose staged rotation tomorrow 07:30 PT. steps: create new key, write into Vault KV (transit-wrapped), shift a canary 10% of traffic, then revoke old. Need RBAC tightening too.
tom: agree. RBAC change: remove broad rolebindings (legacy editor) on the service account; give ingest service accounts `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` only. I'll open TF PR.
infra-bot: PR draft created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/901 — includes vault path `secret/sync/svc-sync/key-v2` and iam_binding delta.
auditsvc: action: export related Create/DeleteServiceAccountKey logs to longterm BQ table `sec_rotations.sa_keys` during the window. filter used: `protoPayload.methodName:("CreateServiceAccountKey" OR "DeleteServiceAccountKey") AND resource.labels.service_account_id:svc-sync`
maya: exact rotation snippet I'll run in staging: ```
# create new key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=svc-sync@redwood-prod
# store wrapped in vault
vault write transit/rotor/plaintext=@new-key.json
vault kv put secret/sync/svc-sync key=@new-key.json
```
elaine: add smoke test: curl to sync health endpoint and validate token exchange path. oncall will run post-canary checks.
oncall: will run token-exchange and downstream assert scripts. also recommend scanning repos/artifacts for the key pattern: `rg "private_key\": \"-----BEGIN" --hidden`
tom: once promoted, we'll run a full artifact sweep and revoke old key with `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID`. Keep rollback: re-enable old key if unexpected failures within 15m.
compliance-bot: note: if KMS key policies change or BYOK involved, open compliance ticket. For this flow (GCP KMS + Vault transit) please attach rotation record and exported audit dataset.
maya: owners: maya=lead, tom=rbac+tf, elaine=rollout, auditsvc=export, oncall=smoke tests. I'll open the compliance notification and schedule the window.
